entries.zh: 女人「你恐怕连这个都看不见！」

entries.en: Woman: Attack increases!
entries.ja: オンナ「コウゲキ　アガルワヨ！」

entries.en: Owner: Eat it all up!
entries.ja: あるじ「もりもりくいねぇ！」

entries.en: Child: The statue of the Goddess is so pretty.
entries.ja: こども「女神さまの石像キレーだなー」

entries.en: Child: But the Princess is even more
entries.ja: こども「女神さまの石像よりも
entries.zh: 小孩「但公主比女神像更美

entries.en: Royal Messenger: <YUSHA_NAME>, a message from the Princess;
entries.ja: 王国伝言兵「<YUSHA_NAME>どの　シエル王女からの伝言です
entries.zh: 皇家传令兵「<YUSHA_NAME>，希尔公主有口信；

entries.en: Clerk-Chief: These days, being chief just isn't enough to pay the bills.
entries.ja: 店番村長「今の時代　村長だけじゃ食ってけないよナー」
entries.zh: 店长村长「如今光当村长可吃不饱。」

entries.en: Clerk-Chief: I made some wooden swords as souvenirs!
entries.ja: 店番村長「ミヤゲ物用に木刀をこさえてみた！
entries.zh: 店长村长「我做了木刀当伴手礼！
